title: RASANE ZULM MEIN NANHI SI KALAAYI HOGI
body:
RASANE ZULM MEIN NANHI SI KALAAYI HOGI
MUJRAEE KAISE SAKINA KO KALAAYI HOGI
<<DIVIDER>>
NAUJAWAN NE JOH SINAA SEENE PAH KHAAYI HOGI
MUJRAEE QAIME SE ZAINAB NIKAL AAYI HOGI
<<DIVIDER>>
SHABE ASHOOR YEH AATI THI SADA-E ZEHRA
SUBAH KO MERE BHARE GHAR KI SAFAAYI HOGI
<<DIVIDER>>
BIBIYAN KEHTI THI YEH RAAT GHANIMAT JANO
KAL TOH EK JAAN PAH LAKHON KI CHADHAAYI HOGI
<<DIVIDER>>
KYA UTHE HOENGE ZAINAB KE JIGAR SE SHOLAY
AAH JAB MASNADE SHABBIR JALAAYI HOGI
<<DIVIDER>>
NAATAWAN DEKH KE ABID KO YEH BOLE RAAH GEER
HAAYE KISNE USEH ZANJEER PINHAAYI HOGI
